# Leafage

> Care app for a small balcony garden. Each user connects a chat assistant to a per-user MCP server, and that assistant is the main way to tend the garden.

Leafage is coming soon. The app already runs at https://app.leafage.garden.

## App

- [Leafage app](https://app.leafage.garden): garden, plants, tasks and account
- [MCP endpoint](https://app.leafage.garden/mcp): streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, one tool per read or verb
